# Test Scenarios — AA-1: User Authentication & Account Management

**Generated by:** Test Scenario Agent (Stage 3)
**Date:** 2026-08-07
**Source:** docs/epics/requirements_AA-1.md (Stage 1) + docs/epics/test_plan_AA-1.md (Stage 2, ✅ Approved)

## AA-10 — Register a new customer account

| ID | Title | Type | Priority | Layer | Preconditions | Description | Expected Result | Test Data Notes | Traceability |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AA-1-SC-01-01 | Successful registration with valid data | Positive | P1 | UI | Visitor is not logged in, on `/auth/register` | Fill all required fields (name, email, password, full address) with valid values and submit | Form submits successfully; user is redirected to `/auth/login` | email = `test_{timestamp}@qa.io`; password meets all 4 visible composition rules and is not breach-listed | AA-10 → AC1 |
| AA-1-SC-01-02 | Registration confirmed at the API layer — no auto-login token issued | Cross-layer | P1 | Cross-layer | Same as above | Submit registration via the UI while capturing network traffic | `POST /users/register` returns 201; no session/auth token is present after the redirect (resolves AC3's "or auto-logs in" ambiguity — live-verified: does not auto-login) | Same dynamic email pattern | AA-10 → AC3 |
| AA-1-SC-01-03 | Duplicate email registration is rejected | Negative | P1 | Cross-layer | An account already exists (e.g. from AA-1-SC-01-01) | Submit the registration form again using the same email address | Registration is rejected with a clear error; `POST /users/register` does not return 201 | Exact error text/status not yet captured live — capture in Stage 4, do not assume wording | AA-10 → AC2 |
| AA-1-SC-01-04 | Required field left blank is rejected | Negative | P2 | UI | On `/auth/register` | Leave one required field empty (repeat per field) and attempt submit | Form does not submit; field-level validation message shown | Cover each required field independently | AA-10 → AC1 |
| AA-1-SC-01-05 | Malformed email format is rejected | Negative | P2 | UI | On `/auth/register` | Enter a syntactically invalid email (e.g. `notanemail`) and submit | Field-level validation error shown; form does not submit | value = `notanemail` | AA-10 → AC1 |
| AA-1-SC-01-06 | Password not meeting composition rules is rejected | Boundary | P2 | UI | On `/auth/register` | Submit a password violating each of the 4 visible rules in turn (too short, no upper, no lower, no number, no special char) | Field-level error shown per violated rule; form does not submit | Boundary: exactly 7 chars vs. 8-char minimum | AA-10 → AC1 |
| AA-1-SC-01-07 | Password appearing in a known data-breach list is rejected (server-side rule) | Edge | P2 | API | On `/auth/register`, password otherwise meets all 4 visible rules | Submit a password known to appear in a public breach list (e.g. `Password123!`) | `POST /users/register` returns `422 Unprocessable Content` with message "The given password has appeared in a data leak. Please choose a different password." | Undocumented in Jira — found via live verification, Stage 1 Edge Case #1 | Not in Jira AC — Stage 1 Edge Case #1 |

## AA-11 — Login with valid credentials

| ID | Title | Type | Priority | Layer | Preconditions | Description | Expected Result | Test Data Notes | Traceability |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AA-1-SC-02-01 | Valid credentials log in and redirect to account page | Positive | P1 | UI | A registered account exists (chain after AA-1-SC-01-01 or API-seeded) | Enter valid email/password on `/auth/login` and submit | User is redirected to `/account` | — | AA-11 → AC1 |
| AA-1-SC-02-02 | Login confirmed at the API layer | Cross-layer | P1 | Cross-layer | Same as above | Submit login via the UI while capturing network traffic | `POST /users/login` returns 200, immediately followed by `GET /users/me` returning 200 | — | AA-11 → AC1 |
| AA-1-SC-02-03 | Logged-in state reflected in header/nav | Positive | P2 | UI | User has just logged in | Inspect the top nav after login | "Sign in" link is replaced by a `{First name} {Last name}` dropdown menu | — | AA-11 → AC3 |
| AA-1-SC-02-04 | Session persists across a full page reload | Positive | P1 | UI | User is logged in, on `/account` | Perform a hard page reload (not in-SPA navigation) | User remains logged in; `/account` still renders authenticated content | Stronger test than in-SPA nav per Stage 1 Edge Case #6 — do not substitute SPA navigation for this | AA-11 → AC2 |
| AA-1-SC-02-05 | Empty email/password blocked from submission | Negative | P3 | UI | On `/auth/login` | Leave email and/or password blank and attempt submit | Form does not submit; client-side validation shown | Implicit — not an explicit Jira AC, standard functional coverage | AA-11 → AC1 (implicit) |

## AA-12 — Login fails with invalid credentials

| ID | Title | Type | Priority | Layer | Preconditions | Description | Expected Result | Test Data Notes | Traceability |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AA-1-SC-03-01 | Wrong password for existing email shows generic error | Negative | P1 | UI | An existing registered email | Submit login with correct email, wrong password | A generic invalid-credentials error is shown | Exact text/status not yet captured live — capture in Stage 4 | AA-12 → AC1 |
| AA-1-SC-03-02 | Non-existent email shows the identical generic error | Negative | P1 | UI | Email address not registered | Submit login with a non-existent email and any password | The SAME generic error text/status as AA-1-SC-03-01 is shown — no user enumeration | Must byte-for-byte match SC-03-01's error text/status — security-relevant assertion | AA-12 → AC2 |
| AA-1-SC-03-03 | No session/token created on failed login | Cross-layer | P1 | Cross-layer | Failed login attempt (either variant above) | After a failed login, check session state | `GET /users/me` still returns 401; no auth token/cookie present | — | AA-12 → AC3 |
| AA-1-SC-03-04 | Required field left empty on login is blocked | Negative | P3 | UI | On `/auth/login` | Leave email or password blank and submit | Form does not submit; client-side validation shown | Implicit — not an explicit Jira AC | AA-12 → AC1 (implicit) |
| AA-1-SC-03-05 | Malformed email format on login is rejected | Negative | P3 | UI | On `/auth/login` | Enter syntactically invalid email and submit | Field-level validation error shown; form does not submit | Implicit — not an explicit Jira AC | AA-12 → AC1 (implicit) |

## AA-13 — Logout

| ID | Title | Type | Priority | Layer | Preconditions | Description | Expected Result | Test Data Notes | Traceability |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AA-1-SC-04-01 | Logout clears session and header reverts to logged-out state | Positive | P1 | UI | User is logged in | Click "Sign out" (`[data-test="nav-sign-out"]`) in the account dropdown | User is navigated to `/auth/login`; header reverts to "Sign in" | — | AA-13 → AC1, AC3 |
| AA-1-SC-04-02 | Logout confirmed at the API layer | Cross-layer | P2 | Cross-layer | User just logged out | Check session state immediately after logout | `GET /users/me` returns 401 | No explicit logout endpoint exists (confirmed live) — logout is client-side token clearing only | AA-13 → AC1 |
| AA-1-SC-04-03 | Unauthenticated access to `/account` after logout | Negative | P2 | UI | User is logged out | Navigate directly to `/account` while unauthenticated | **Per AC2, expected:** redirect to login. **Live-observed:** no redirect occurs — URL stays at `/account`, page renders no content below the nav | Contradicts AC2 as written — flagged in Stage 2 Risk Register; needs PO/security decision before this scenario's `Then` step is finalized in Stage 4 | AA-13 → AC2 (**disputed** — see Ambiguity #1, requirements doc) |
| AA-1-SC-04-04 | Unauthenticated access to cart/checkout after logout | Negative | P2 | Cross-layer | User is logged out | Navigate directly to a protected checkout step while unauthenticated | Same guard question as SC-04-03 applies — cross-cutting per Stage 3 epic-specific guidance | Depends on the same PO/security decision as SC-04-03 | AA-13 → AC2 (**disputed**) |
| AA-1-SC-04-05 | `GET /users/refresh` reproducibility check post-logout | Edge | P3 | API | User just logged out | Observe network traffic for ~5s after logout completes | Confirm whether `GET /users/refresh` reliably returns 500 (observed once) | Candidate for `@known-bug` (Category C) vs `@flaky` (Category D) — classify per Stage 1 Ambiguity #2 before tagging | Not in Jira AC — Stage 1 Ambiguity #2 |

## AA-14 — Update profile information

| ID | Title | Type | Priority | Layer | Preconditions | Description | Expected Result | Test Data Notes | Traceability |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AA-1-SC-05-01 | Profile form pre-filled with current values | Positive | P2 | UI | User is logged in, navigates to `/account/profile` | Inspect the profile-fields form on load | First name, last name, email, phone, street, postal code, city, state, country are pre-filled with the registered values | Scope: profile-fields form (`[data-test="update-profile-submit"]`) only — password-change and 2FA sections are out of scope per Stage 2 | AA-14 → AC1 |
| AA-1-SC-05-02 | Valid profile update is saved and reflected immediately | Positive | P1 | UI | User is on `/account/profile` | Change one or more profile fields to new valid values and submit | Update is saved; new values are reflected immediately on the page without reload | — | AA-14 → AC2 |
| AA-1-SC-05-03 | Malformed email in profile update is rejected | Negative | P2 | UI | User is on `/account/profile` | Enter a syntactically invalid email in the profile form and submit | Field-level error shown; update is not saved | Exact error text not yet captured live — capture in Stage 4 | AA-14 → AC3 |
| AA-1-SC-05-04 | Required field left blank on profile update is rejected | Negative | P3 | UI | User is on `/account/profile` | Clear a required field (e.g. first name) and submit | Field-level validation error shown; update is not saved | Implicit — not an explicit Jira AC | AA-14 → AC3 (implicit) |
| AA-1-SC-05-05 | Unauthenticated access to `/account/profile` | Cross-layer | P2 | Cross-layer | User is logged out | Navigate directly to `/account/profile` while unauthenticated | Subject to the same guard question as AA-1-SC-04-03/04 — apply whatever behavior is confirmed for that decision | Cross-cutting requirement applied per-story, not a distinct AA-14 AC | Cross-cutting — Stage 3 epic-specific guidance |

## Summary

**Total scenarios: 27**

**By type:** Positive: 7 | Negative: 12 | Boundary: 1 | Edge: 2 | Cross-layer: 5

**By layer:** UI: 18 | API: 2 | Cross-layer: 7

**By priority:** P1: 11 | P2: 11 | P3: 5 | P4: 0

**Open items carried into Stage 4:** 4 scenarios (SC-01-03, SC-03-01, SC-03-02, SC-05-03) need exact error text/status captured live before Gherkin `Then` steps can be written precisely; 2 scenarios (SC-04-03, SC-04-04) are blocked on a PO/security decision about AC2's redirect-guard behavior.
